تذدكروا (form VIII)
# تَذْدَكِرُوا (taḏdakirū) /tað.da.ki.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# تُذْدَكَرُوا (tuḏdakarū) /tuð.da.ka.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
